appropriateAge.label:
For  cats and dogs, we recommend waiting until puppies and kittens are at least 3 weeks old before testing.

For other species, hair samples can be collected at any time. However, for very young foals, we recommend pulling hairs from the tail instead of the mane. Mane hairs of very young foals are too thin and do not have good roots for testing.

dnaKits_dogs_yes.label: When you place an order and select "Sample Choice B" (default), a DNA kit is sent to you the next business day via US Mail for no additional charge. Please note that kits can take 1-2 weeks to arrive at their US destinations, and up to 4-6 weeks for overseas locations. If it has been longer than that, we apologize for the inconvenience. Please contact our customer service team and they will be happy to mail a new kit out to you. If time is of the essence, you can provide one of the alternative brushes we accept. Visit Click here. to learn more.

dnaKits_dogs_no.label: A kit will be sent to you via US mail once you place an order online. To order a test, you will first need to create an account on our website: - Go to Click here. - Select “Create an Account” - Create an account online by filling in your information and creating a password To order the test: - Login to your account at: Click here. - Click on "Order Tests" and select "Dog" under the drop-down menu - Fill in the dog’s information - Select test(s) of choice - Select either Sample Choice A or B -- “Sample Choice B” is our laboratory’s default and preferred choice, as our cytology brushes have proven to produce more viable samples - Read and Select “Terms and Conditions” - Read and Select the checkbox that acknowledges our current turnaround time - Select “Save” -- If ordering for more than one dog, click on “Order test(s) for new animal” before checking out and repeat the previous steps for the next animal - Select “Proceed to Checkout” - Pay online You will receive a payment confirmation email after completing the checkout process. If you choose Sample Choice B, our laboratory will mail you the pre-labeled cytology brushes to collect the sample and a sample collection brochure. The sample collection brochure will include our laboratory’s mailing addresses. If you select Sample Choice A and choose to use your own interdental/gum brushes, the email will also include the submission form and instructions on how to send in your attached sample. For information about collecting a sufficient sample: Click here. We strongly recommend obtaining a tracking number when you mail the samples back so they can be monitored in transit.

testResults_none_registry.label:
When a sample is submitted through a registry, results are sent directly to the registry. Per our contract, we are not able to provide results to anyone but the registry.

Please contact the registry to obtain a copy of your results.

If you would like to confirm that the VGL has received your sample, or if you need additional assistance, please contact our customer service team with the sample ID for your submission.

howToOrder_cat_parentage.label: To order parentage verification: - Login to your account at: Click here. - Click on "Order Tests" and select “Cat” under the drop-down menu - Fill in the animal’s information - Select "Parent Verification" - Select "Verify Sire to this animal" - - If you know the VGL Case ID of the possible sire(s), you can enter it or you can search for the sire in your account by clicking on "Search My Account". If the possible sire has not been tested, select "Add new sire". You can add as many sires as needed. - Select "Verify Dam to this animal" if desired - - If you know the VGL Case ID of the possible dam, you can enter it or you can search for the dam in your account by clicking on "Search My Account". If the possible dam has not been tested, select "Add new dam". You can add as many dams as needed. - Read and select “Terms and Conditions” - Read and Select the checkbox that acknowledges our current turnaround time - Select “Save” - - If ordering for multiple cats, click on “Order test(s) for new animal” before checking out and repeat the previous steps for the next animal - Select “Proceed to Checkout” - Pay Online You will receive a payment confirmation email with the submission form attached for you to print. The submission form provides sample instructions, the return addresses, and a place to tape the sample directly to the form. The sample requirement is a cheek swab using 2 double-ended cotton swabs (all 4 ends used) or 4 single-ended cotton swabs. For information about collecting a sufficient sample: Click here. We strongly recommend obtaining a tracking number when you mail the samples back so they can be monitored in transit.

turnaround_horse.label: Our average turnaround time is approximately 10 business days from the day a sample is received for results to be reported, except for Gray Copy Number and Skeletal Atavism which take an average of 15 business days. The same turnaround time should be expected when a new test is added to a sample we already have at the laboratory. Once testing concludes, results will be sent to the email address in your My VGL account. You can also view/print your test results when they have been completed directly from your account: - Log onto Click here. - Select “Login to My Account” - Select “View Tests/Results” - Select the “Result” link to the far right of animal’s name If it has been longer than expected, please contact our customer service team so they can further assist you.
